units.source_text: 自三四年前起，每年夏冬是温泉浴场最繁忙的季节。

en.t: For the past three or four years, summer and winter had been the busiest seasons at the hot spring resort.

units.source_text: 每到这时候，仓吉不知从哪儿又忽然回到这家温泉旅馆里来。

en.t: Whenever that time came, Kurakichi would suddenly return to this hot spring inn again, from no one knew where.

units.source_text: 因为他是在旅馆旺季，杂务纷繁的时刻露面，

en.t: Because he appeared during the inn's busy season, when miscellaneous work was piling up,

units.source_text: 旅馆人手不够，就自然而然地让他帮厨，

en.t: the inn was short of hands, so they naturally had him help in the kitchen,

units.source_text: 或让他迎送客人，就这样把他留了下来。

en.t: or had him see guests off and welcome them in, and in this way they kept him there.

units.source_text: 因此每年这个时节，旅馆的人就想起他来，说：“今年仓吉也该来啦。”

en.t: So every year at this season, the people at the inn would remember him and say, "Kurakichi should be coming this year too."
